topics.description: Minnesota's lawsuit against the Trump administration over $243M in withheld Medicaid funding is a developing story. The state is seeking to recover the funds, which were frozen by the federal government.
topics.reason: High-stakes lawsuit between Minnesota and federal government

topics.description: The Minnesota state prosecutor has opened an investigation into Greg Bovino and federal agents' use of unlawful force. This comes amid allegations of misconduct by Bovino and ICE officers.
topics.reason: New investigation into law enforcement misconduct
